title: Riftn.com has acquired the Fansite ecosystem
html:
Riftn.com has acquired the Fansite ecosystem, including any of its assets and all associated intellectual property. All team members and contributors allocated tokens have either been bought out or had their agreement cancelled.

At the launch of $RIFT, all investors will be eligible to claim 100 $RIFT for every BJ token they hold, with no lock or vest. Unless announced and executed via governance proposals, each $RIFT token is listing at a price of 0.001 with a supply of 8 billion.

Investors (only presale and open market buyers) who register at Riftn.com before December 7 will also qualify for a substantial bonus on top of airdrops. The exact bonus amount and its vesting schedule will be confirmed closer to the $RIFT listing.

A listing date has yet to be announced. In the meantime, you can register at Riftn.com and start using your tokens on the platform immediately. Every feature and utility promised for Fansite is already available on Riftn.com.

Access to adult content is managed through account settings on the web and in the mobile apps. Apple and Google do prohibit explicit pornography on public feeds in apps distributed through the App Store and Google Play.

Thank you to everyone who invested and helped build this community. We hope this news brings joy to all and appreciate your patience throughout this transition.

Looking forward to welcoming you to Riftn.com.
